routeIdea:
My idea is a route for "The Hawaiian Island Hop", which is real world.
The  pitch for this route is "A journey across the Hawaiian Islands, exploring the diverse landscapes from volcanic craters to lush rainforests and pristine beaches.".
Some ideas for steps are: 
	 - Hilo, Hawaii (Big Island) to Kailua-Kona, Hawaii (Big Island)
	 - Kailua-Kona, Hawaii (Big Island) to Haleakalā National Park, Maui
	 - Haleakalā National Park, Maui to Lahaina, Maui
	 - Lahaina, Maui to Waikiki, Oahu
	 - Waikiki, Oahu to Na Pali Coast, Kauai

itinerary.startingLocationDescription: Begin your journey in Hilo, known for its lush rainforests and proximity to Hawaii Volcanoes National Park.
itinerary.endingLocationDescription: Travel to Kailua-Kona, famous for its sunny weather and historic sites.
itinerary.anyExtraInformationOnHowToFind: Follow the Mamalahoa Highway (Route 19) for a scenic drive along the coast.

itinerary.startingLocationDescription: Explore the vibrant town of Kailua-Kona, with its beautiful beaches and coffee farms.
itinerary.endingLocationDescription: Fly to Maui and visit Haleakalā National Park, known for its stunning volcanic landscapes.
itinerary.anyExtraInformationOnHowToFind: Flights available from Kona International Airport to Kahului Airport in Maui.

itinerary.startingLocationDescription: Discover the breathtaking views from the summit of Haleakalā, a dormant volcano.
itinerary.endingLocationDescription: Drive to Lahaina, a historic town with a vibrant arts scene and waterfront dining.
itinerary.anyExtraInformationOnHowToFind: Take the Hana Highway (Route 36) and then the Honoapiilani Highway (Route 30) to reach Lahaina.

itinerary.startingLocationDescription: Enjoy the charming streets of Lahaina, with its art galleries and historic sites.
itinerary.endingLocationDescription: Fly to Oahu and explore Waikiki, famous for its iconic beach and vibrant nightlife.
itinerary.anyExtraInformationOnHowToFind: Flights available from Kahului Airport in Maui to Honolulu International Airport in Oahu.

itinerary.startingLocationDescription: Experience the bustling atmosphere of Waikiki, with its shopping and dining options.
itinerary.endingLocationDescription: Fly to Kauai and visit the Na Pali Coast, known for its dramatic cliffs and hiking trails.
itinerary.anyExtraInformationOnHowToFind: Flights available from Honolulu International Airport to Lihue Airport in Kauai.
